name: ai-gym-fitness-assistant
description: Root-level runner: starts both the FastAPI backend and the Vite frontend with a single command.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn main:app --reload
scripts.install:all: cd backend && uv venv && uv pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ../frontend && npm install
